subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration fit & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lee <sara.lee@acme.com>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration fit & next steps

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Helpful conversation — summarizing the key points and proposed next steps so we have alignment. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of customer goals / pain:
- Primary goal: real-time chat + knowledge retrieval for support agents (sub-100ms token latency target for agent UI).
- Pain: current latency / cold-starts with their self-hosted model, and cost volatility during peak ticket volume.
- Relevance gap: search/faq retrieval returns noisy results; they want better reranking and embedding-based semantic search.
- Compliance: requirement to keep logs for 12 months and integrate with their KMS for key management.

How Redwood maps to those needs (product fit):
- Streaming + SDK changes: Our streaming SDK will let them render partial responses in the agent UI to meet perceived latency SLOs while tokenization finishes. We recommended continuous batching tuned to their 95th percentile request size.
- Function calling: Use function calling to let the model call internal tools (ticket lookup, customer metadata) — reduces hallucination and keeps outputs structured.
- Structured outputs: We can return JSON schemas for ticket classification and suggested priority/severity so their UI can consume without extra parsing.
- Embeddings + reranking: Propose embedding-based candidate retrieval + a lightweight reranker to improve FAQ relevance; we can run a small pilot on their ticket corpus.
- Deployment options: Start on Hosted API for quick POC, then move to Dedicated (reserved capacity) for predictable latency and cost, or Private if they require VPC and KMS integration.

Action items / next steps:
1) Acme: share a sample dataset (anonymized tickets + KB) for an initial embedding + rerank pilot — target: next Tue (2027-04-06).
2) Redwood (Marissa): send integration summary doc + estimated scope for a pilot (attached).
3) Redwood (Ethan): schedule a technical deep-dive for SDK/function-calling and streaming mechanics — target: week of 4/12.
4) Acme & Redwood: agree on success metrics for pilot (latency P95 <= 250ms for token stream, 10-20% uplift in FAQ click-through through reranking).

Attachments: redwood_integration_summary.pdf (concise POC plan) and mvp_scope.xlsx (high-level resource/estimate).

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

—Marissa

Hi Marissa —

This looks great and captures the discussion. A few clarifications:
- We can share a scrubbed sample of ~5k tickets + our current FAQ corpus by EOD Monday (4/05).
- For compliance: we do need KMS integration and SOC2 evidence before moving to Dedicated/Private; for the POC, Hosted is OK but we need to validate logs retention behavior.
- Latency target: P95 <= 250ms perceived is fine, but for agent experience we'll measure end-to-end UI latency.

Next for us: I’ll attach the anonymized sample to the HubSpot deal once it’s ready. In parallel, Tom and I are available for the technical deep-dive on 4/13 or 4/14.
